results.rationale: Consistency: the two upper diamonds, lower-left subdivided square and outer frame remain intact. Instruction: the bottom-right shape becomes a square, but it contains both central dividing lines; an empty square was required. Knowledge: retaining the cross conflicts with the specified removal-of-inner-lines pattern. Quality: the diagram is legible and coherent, with slightly uneven strokes on the new square.

Consistency: car identity, red body, wheel design and headlight arrangement remain recognizable; the small hood badge loses detail. Instruction: the car is lowered within a blurred dark city scene with neon accents and the correct upper-left slogan, but Ferrari is large at bottom-right instead of small at bottom-center, and the large embossed headline weakens the requested minimalism. Quality: lettering and car geometry are coherent, but bright daylight/tree reflections on the car conflict with the night setting and the large road reflection looks distorted.
